items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: That's a brother they call Roscoe Williams. That's all he used to play with the blues.

ctx.x: Ask who played the best, the best blues on piano.
Who played the best blues on piano? The piano, piano, piano. That's a brother they call Roscoe Williams. That's all he used to play with the blues. Don't know his name? Don't know anybody. Roscoe?
What's his name? Who? Roscoe Williams?
